auth.readyVerify: the authenticated Pick home screen with a 'Scan My Network' button and a connector rail on the left is visible

scenes.caption: Ask Pick to scan your network — it runs the tools for you

steps.act: click the large 'Scan My Network' button at the top
steps.verify: the agent is executing tool calls (a Phase / device_info step with a success badge is visible)
a Network Discovery Report summary with host counts and security findings is visible

scenes.caption: Every scan becomes a shareable report

steps.act: click the 'Network Discovery Report' entry under 'DOCUMENTS FROM THIS CHAT' near the bottom
steps.verify: the report document is open showing an Executive Summary heading

steps.act: click the share icon in the top-right corner of the report header
steps.verify: a share menu or share affordance is shown

scenes.caption: Turn off Easy Mode to reveal KubeStudio

steps.act: click the settings gear icon at the bottom of the far-left rail
steps.verify: an 'Easy mode' toggle control is visible on screen

steps.act: click the 'Easy mode' toggle to turn it OFF
steps.verify: both a KubeStudio card and a Pick card are shown (advanced connectors revealed)
the KubeStudio Kubernetes dashboard (Cluster Overview with Nodes/Pods/Workloads) is visible

scenes.caption: Pick has an Easy Mode too — flip it off for the expert view

steps.act: click the Pick (shield) icon in the far-left connector rail
steps.verify: the Pick home screen is visible

steps.act: click the hamburger menu icon at the top-left next to the 'Pick' title
steps.verify: a slide-out menu with 'New chat', 'Reports', and 'Settings' is visible
the Pick Settings screen with an 'Easy Mode' toggle is visible

steps.act: click the 'Easy Mode' toggle to turn it off
steps.verify: the full expert Pentest dashboard with a Tools/Shell/Chat nav and Quick Actions grid is visible
